model.title: Department of Homeland Security Intelligence and Analysis Training Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Homeland Security Committee · Rep. Seth Magaziner (D-RI)

summary.text: The bill would require the Department of Homeland Security's Office of Intelligence and Analysis to establish standardized training programs for new employees covering privacy rights, civil liberties, and intelligence standards, with specialized curricula tailored to different job roles such as analysts and open-source intelligence collectors. It would also require the office to track training completion and direct the Government Accountability Office to report to Congress on how these new training programs compare to those offered by other intelligence agencies.
